changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Text Summarization' as the paper frames Rotowire as data-to-text generation, not summarization. Consolidated duplicate 'Other:Data-to-text Generation'. Normalized model names to be specific (BERT-base/large/small instead of generic BERT). Removed vague output descriptions and kept the two specific NLG outputs mentioned.
BLEU is correctly extracted and normalized. The paper only uses BLEU for evaluating generated outputs on Rotowire data-to-text generation.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper only uses LLMs (BERT, T5, BART) as models to be improved, not as evaluators.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper. All evaluations are automatic.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on a regularization technique (Token-Level Masking) for Transformers, with evaluations across multiple NLP tasks. Only the data-to-text generation (Rotowire) and grammatical error correction (CGED) tasks involve natural language generation. The NLG evaluation is limited to automatic metrics (BLEU only), with no human or LLM-as-judge evaluation.
